excludedScenario: Attempted registration with an incorrect predecessor
exclusionReason: Removed from the agreed RQ1 interface and evaluation scope.

requirements.description: AI analysis produces a review draft without persisting SQL or blockchain state.
A reviewed policy produces complete SQL and blockchain records.
An unclear extracted field remains explicit and is marked for review.
A human correction is stored with human_edited status and before/after evidence.
A later version receives a new record key and links to the prior version.
The earlier version remains unchanged after a later version is registered.
Stored bytes, hashes, chunk counts, and ordered commitments pass the chain audit.
Duplicate policy content is rejected without changing SQL or blockchain state.
Both current and earlier versions can be resolved after an update.
The earlier version remains independently auditable by record key.
The registered latest policy is accepted by verification.
Modified policy content is rejected and the failed comparisons are identified.
